Filing gate: ③ the maintainer's ruling on #32627 (「…其他同意」, decision batch #2, triage#1 session). The card closed on PR #32853; its item 5 moves here as a measurement with no fix promised. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What

#32627 recorded that the executive dashboard's charts took 20–25 s to appear. That was one reading, on a slow link to a HotCRM environment. Nobody has measured it on a normal link, so it is unknown whether this is the real user-facing cost in the list and dashboard work or an artefact of the link.

## Do

1. On a normal link, open the HotCRM executive dashboard (and one showcase dashboard as a CONTROL) with a cold and a warm cache.
2. Record per-request `Server-Timing` and browser timing for each chart's dataset query: whether the queries run in parallel or in series, server time against transfer time, and time to first and last chart.
3. Report the numbers on this card. If a chart takes more than a few seconds on a normal link, name the slow step (query, analytics resolve, render) and file the fix card at the grade the numbers justify.

## Grade

p2 (#32997). It is a measurement of a possibly user-visible slowness with no fix attached.

Reader: `domain:ui` (with `domain:server` if the time is server-side).
